instruction: Look at outer_plate.step in SOLIDWORKS with the SOLIDWORKS CAM add-in. Create a Profile or Contour outside-boundary operation for outer_plate.step. Set the Coordinate System origin at the part top-face center. Use an installed flat end mill to machine the outside profile/contour. Apply 0.2 mm radial stock and one finish pass. Use the standard Profile or Contour operation and keep SOLIDWORKS CAM's default generated NC comments; do not rename operations just to add labels. Do not force exact tool station numbers, spindle speeds, feedrates, or internal tool-library IDs if SOLIDWORKS CAM's Technology Database assigns stable defaults; use suitable installed tool-library entries for the required operation types and let the posted NC program reflect those real CAM selections. Save the required output file(s) to the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-2.nc. Generate the required NC/G-code file(s) by using SOLIDWORKS CAM's normal Post Process workflow after calculating the toolpath, with an installed .ctl postprocessor from C:\ProgramData\SOLIDWORKS\SOLIDWORKS CAM 2025\Posts. For milling tasks, prefer m3axis-tutorial.ctl, mach_iii.ctl, or haas_vf3.ctl; for turning tasks, use an installed turning .ctl post such as fanuc_t2axis.ctl. If the generated program opens in NC Editor or is initially saved with a different extension, use Save As from that generated program to save the exact requested Desktop filename(s). Do not manually write, fabricate, or directly create the NC/G-code text outside SOLIDWORKS CAM. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
